testName: Create New Lead and Verify Assignment Rules
steps:
1. Open Leads tab
2. Click on New button
3. Enter "Marcus" in First Name
4. Enter "Vance" in Last Name
5. Enter "Apex Cloud Technologies" in Company
6. Select "Technology" from Industry picklist
7. Enter "marcus.vance@apexcloud.example" in Email field
8. Select "USA" from Country field
9. Click on Save button
10. Verify toast "Lead was created"
11. Verify field "Lead Status" equals "Open - Not Contacted"
